title: token-conditioned Mirror ReFT
hypothesis: On a two-context held-out token prediction mechanism task generated by one shared low-rank representation intervention with context-dependent rank-space rotations, a context-generated Givens Mirror code recovers the target better per serialized byte than shared-basis conditional FiLM and ordinary LoReFT, while approaching independently stored LoReFT interventions.

mirror_insertion.physical_object: one shared rank-4 A/B hidden-state intervention basis
mirror_insertion.coordinate: a six-angle Givens transform generated from the current token/context scalar and applied between A and B
mirror_insertion.logical_functions: token/context-specific hidden-state functions at each sequence position
controls: independent full rank-4 intervention upper control

task.input: per-position 16D features plus a scalar binary context token; each position receives a context generated independently for the example
task.target: frozen deterministic teacher: output is a shared rank-4 intervention with one of two fixed Givens rotations applied according to context
task.data_generation: independent counter-based seeds; audit generator is not called unless every development gate passes

training.development_selection: choose the common learning rate minimizing mean paired (Mirror MSE minus FiLM MSE) on development across both seeds; if tied, choose lower rate. All methods are trained at both rates.
training.fresh_learning_rate: locked from development before fresh generation

metrics: actual serialized inference payload bytes including context generator and metadata

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload byte length

gates.development: Freeze candidate hyperparameters only; no audit access unless every fresh seed gate below is subsequently met.
gates.fresh_pass: Across all three fresh seeds, Mirror MSE <= 1.10x independent two-intervention LoReFT, Mirror payload <= 0.80x independent LoReFT payload, and Mirror MSE <= 0.98x byte-matched shared-basis FiLM MSE; FiLM and Mirror payloads must differ by <=5%.
gates.failure: Mirror misses any quality/storage gate in at least two of three fresh seeds, or FiLM is within 2% MSE at equal/lower payload.
gates.audit: Generate/evaluate audit examples only if every frozen fresh gate passes. Audit cannot change the result classification or settings.

boundaries: teacher is deliberately intervention-structured and does not establish natural-language benefit
two context values do not establish arbitrary token-function multiplicity
